text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go to the cafeteria and run into
Wonder Acute
clutching a paper bag.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Your timing couldn't be
better.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was just about to make some snacks.
Care to
join me for a cup of tea?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking I can help out in some way, I
follow her
to the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: First, we need the right... utensils... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Acute! Did you come here to make

something?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence. We'll be here for
the next
two hours baking a
Käsetorte—or cheesecake, as
you may
know it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Since we're all here, why don't we all
cook
together? Let's make something
super tasty and
super cute! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, what a very kind offer. How
could I
refuse?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we all decide to make a cake
together...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That should do it.
Next should be,
umm...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Set the oven to 180 degrees Celsius and
roll out
a 5-millimeter crust while it
preheats for fifteen
minutes.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now I mix the quark with a spatula, and
then add
the sugar...
And then, um,
where's the sieve...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Finished. The crust is a perfect golden
brown.
Acute, how is your progress on
the filling?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mmph! Yah! Hraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Acute?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nearly there. I've got to keep straining it
until all
the clumps are gone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
They're going at completely different
paces! Is
this really gonna work?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two have very distinct approaches.
Curious
how things will turn out, I stand
back and watch.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You've strained the cream quite
thoroughly, and
it's turned out
beautifully. Wunderbar!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was no bother, really. I just want
this to
taste as good as it can be.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And I must say, Flash, you're quite
efficient. I'm
very impressed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You were even cleaning up as you went
along. I
could never pull that off.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well... I believe I have my upbringing to
thank for
that, but I appreciate the
compliment.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It seems like things are actually
going well.
This just might work!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Neither of them looked at
the recipe
much.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I'm just used to it. Make
something a
couple dozen times, and it's
not that hard to
remember what to do.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A couple dozen?! Yeah, I'll pass!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, we all enjoy the finished
Käsetorte
together.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's true! They were going at different
speeds,
but they both made sure
everything was done just
right! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Once I start something, I tend
to get
rather absorbed. Sorry it took so
long.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I think you were magnificent. Let us
bring this
cake to completion hand in
hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, we all enjoy the finished
Käsetorte
together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
How peculiar... We followed the
standard recipe,
yet something about
the cake seems... different.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be the reaction between your
efficiency
and Acute's easygoing
vibes! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I didn't do anything special, but
I'm thrilled
if I was able to make a
difference.
